messages:
Sarah (PM): Quick follow-up from the cache-stampede postmortem — we need owners + jira tickets for the action items. recurring pattern: p95 token bursts when cache miss ratio spikes. Can folks claim by EOD Fri?
Tom (SRE): I can own the root-cause writeup and bench repro. assigning JIRA-4127. Will post a short repro log.
Maya (SRE): I can take alerting + runbook updates. creating JIRA-4128. Will add playbook steps and rollback notes.
Priya (Infra): I'll own autoscale tuning + capacity guardrails. JIRA-4129. Need a list of traffic pulses to simulate.
Tom (SRE): RACI proposal:
```
R: Tom (root cause + repro)
A: Sarah (PM) for closure
C: Maya, Priya (runbook / infra)
I: eng-oncall rotation + product analytics
```
Maya (SRE): +1 to RACI. For runbook I'll include the quick mitigation (force-cache-fill script) and a pointer to the KV cache metrics dashboard.
Priya (Infra): For autoscale, I need current scaling policy JSON and the histogram of inter-request intervals. @Tom can you drop the pulse trace?
Tom (SRE): Dropping trace here: `s3://redwood-artifacts/incident/1748601234/pulse-trace.log` — contains 30s bursts. Also repro command: `./simulate_load --burst 30 --rps 1200`
remediation-bot: Remediation checklist created: JIRA-4127, JIRA-4128, JIRA-4129. Due-date default set to 2025-03-21. Use `/remediate extend <ticket>` to change.
Sarah (PM): Can we pick owners for verification/qa? Suggest: verification = Maya (alerts + runbook) and Tom (repro). Due dates: Tom: 2025-03-14 for RC writeup; Maya: 2025-03-18 for runbook; Priya: 2025-03-20 for autoscale changes.
Maya (SRE): I'll add a small synthetic test to the chaos harness and link it to the alert run. That will help validate.
Priya (Infra): Plan for staged rollout: dev -> canary -> prod across clusters. I'll do a canary next Tue, target 5% traffic.
Tom (SRE): Pairing offer: I can pair with Priya for the canary if helpful.
Sarah (PM): Please add the Jira links in the postmortem doc and set the epic to INC-17486. Also set ticket labels: `postmortem-action`, `recurring-pattern`.
Maya (SRE): Quick question: do we want a weekly follow-up for 3 weeks to catch regressions?
Sarah (PM): Yes — weekly sync for 3 weeks. I'll create a calendar: Thu 10am starting 2025-03-13.
remediation-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly-checkin (3 occurrences) starting 2025-03-13.
Priya (Infra): Noted. I'll post the canary plan doc and the expected metrics to hit.
Tom (SRE): Added acceptance criteria to JIRA-4127: reproduces p95 spike locally, includes mitigation script, links to traces.
Sarah (PM): Summary: Owners and tickets -> Tom JIRA-4127 (RC + repro) due 2025-03-14, Maya JIRA-4128 (runbook + alerts + verification) due 2025-03-18, Priya JIRA-4129 (autoscale change + canary) due 2025-03-20. Weekly check-ins scheduled. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maya (SRE): ACK :white_check_mark:
Tom (SRE): ACK :thumbsup:
Priya (Infra): ACK :rocket:
Sarah (PM): I'll close the loop after the first week and update the postmortem doc with the jira links. If anyone needs deadline shifts, ping me.
remediation-bot: Thread closed for new claims after EOD 2025-03-07 (to keep action ownership stable).
